jobs.description:
About the company:

Our client, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company introducing innovative CAR-T cell therapy. Their team is making a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a strong growth phase and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading biotechnology company, is looking for individuals interested in joining their team as a Support Operator/Laboratory Disinfection Specialist.

Before you join their professional team, you will receive thorough training in aseptic (germ-free) work, GMP, and related procedures. As a support operator, you will be responsible for maintaining the assigned areas and production zones in the laboratory in spotless condition. With the utmost precision, you will ensure the maintenance of equipment used, and the cleanliness and disinfection of materials. You will handle cleaning agents and materials safely and correctly. The laboratory works with biological products in a strictly controlled environment where your attention to detail can impact human lives.

 

Step into the world of biotechnology and become part of a dynamic team!

Profile:

• Cleanliness and order are very important to you.

• Experience in a sterile environment is a plus.

• You are enthusiastic about teamwork and can work well both independently and in a group.

• You are highly proficient in English.

• You have at least basic knowledge of MS Office (as a large part of the job involves recording, reporting, and online training).

• Wearing a sterile suit and strictly following procedures is no problem for you.

About the Company:

Our client, headquartered in Zwijnaarde, is a leading global biotechnology company introducing groundbreaking cell therapy to Ghent. Their dedicated team plays a crucial role in improving the lives of patients battling cancer and other severe illnesses. As they continue to grow, they are looking for motivated and committed individuals to join their dynamic workforce.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an innovative and rapidly expanding biotech company, we are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate.

Responsibilities:

As a Warehouse Associate, you will be responsible for:

• Handling biohazard materials such as blood bags and viral vectors in a temperature-controlled environment.
• Accurately processing incoming inventory by verifying purchase orders, conducting quality checks, and ensuring compliance with company policies.
• Managing equipment and materials stored at cryogenic temperatures.
• Completing Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for received goods, including transportation inspections, temperature control, integrity verification, and proper documentation.
• Filling in necessary forms and logbooks related to receiving, picking, and outbound operations in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
• Collaborating closely with the Operations and Quality departments to facilitate production and laboratory activities at the start-up site.
• Working in a sterile environment while wearing specialized protective clothing.
• Using two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to manage inbound, picking, and outbound logistics.
• Coordinating with accounting, suppliers, and business stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile:

• High school diploma or associate’s degree.
• Prior warehouse experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to complete administrative tasks such as filling out forms and maintaining logbooks.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across various levels of the organization.
• Problem-solving mindset with solid analytical and data interpretation skills.
• Strict adherence to protocols to ensure product quality and personal safety at all times.
• Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of responsibility.
• Proficiency in English is essential.

Onze klant, een biotech bedrijf, gevestigd in Zwijnaarde, is een wereldwijd biotechnologiebedrijf dat de innovatieve CAR-T celtheraptie naar Gent brengt. Het bedrijf maakt hiermee dagdagelijks het verschil in het leven van vele patiënten die lijden aan kanker en andere levensbedreigende ziektes.Ze zijn momenteel in een fase van sterke groei en zoeken gemotiveerde en toegewijde teamleden. 

Jobomschrijving

We’re looking for skilled individuals to join our mission of transforming medicine. This is more than just a job,it’s an opportunity to advance your career in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment. Whether you have a secondary education with hands-on experience or are a recent graduate with a bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related fields and especially if you’ve worked in cleanrooms, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or chemical processing,we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for dedicated process operators to join our team at a leading biotechnology company. What can you expect in this exciting role?

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

Daily aseptic and manual production processes

Working in a cleanroom lab environment

Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products.

Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance

Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials

Supporting transitions between production zones

Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

A strong sense of responsibility and passion to make a difference in the lives of patients.

Clear verbal and written communication skills with an attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures.

You thrive in fast-paced environments and are eager to learn and grow in advanced biomanufacturing.

You like structure and order, are very accurate and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.

You have a relevant 'graduaat' or a bachelor’s degree. Alternatively, if you hold a secondary education diploma and have initial experience in a lab or cleanroom or hospital environment, pharmaceutical manufacturing, chemical processing, or similar regulated industries you are also eligible.

You are willing to work in a shift regime 4 days of working 4 days.

You speak very good English.

You’re excited to work with cutting-edge equipment and technologies

Our client is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. The company serves a diverse global marketplace with innovative polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials. With a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide, our client has established itself as a global industry leader, recognized for its high-quality products, advanced manufacturing technologies, and commitment to employee development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for:

• Operating and setting up production machines according to production guidelines and specifications.
• Cutting and processing foam blocks based on customer and production requirements.
• Performing quality checks on finished products, including dimensions, shape, color, and compliance with specifications.
• Using measuring tools during the production process.
• Registering production data and labeling products in the Carpy system.
• Transporting materials and products between workstations using an electric pallet truck.
• Ensuring the proper operation of machinery and carrying out basic maintenance tasks when required.

Requirements

• Previous experience in a production or manufacturing environment.
• Technical aptitude and an interest in operating machinery.
• Ability to work independently with a strong sense of responsibility and attention to quality.
• Good teamwork and communication skills.
• Working knowledge of English or Dutch sufficient for workplace communication.

Our client is a leader in the wind energy industry.

Jobomschrijving

The main responsibilities for this position are: providing maintenance, repair and support for wind turbines throughout Belgium to ensure the continuous operation of the machines.

The team leaves in the morning with a van from a service point. The service points are in: Jabbeke, Lokeren, Stabroek (Antwerp/Kapellen).

Profile:

- as wind turbine technician you have a bachelor's degree in a technical field or professional experience in a similar position

- knowledge of mechanics and/or electricity

- able to work at very high heights and in limited space

- you have a B driver's license

- you can speak English, French or Dutch

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Jobomschrijving

For our client in Lokeren, we are looking for a motivated Pallet Repair Worker to join a stable and growing company. You will work in a modern pallet repair line during the day shift, where quality, safety, and teamwork are essential.

Your responsibilities

• Repair damaged wooden pallets according to EPAL quality standards.
• Use a pneumatic nail gun to attach boards and blocks.
• Replace damaged pallet components, such as boards and blocks.
• Inspect pallets for quality, dimensions, and compliance with EPAL standards.
• Check chamfered edges and the overall condition of the pallets.
• Sort pallets based on their condition and repair requirements.
• Keep your workplace safe, clean, and well organized.
• Work closely with your colleagues to ensure an efficient production process.

Who are we looking for?

• Experience in a production, woodworking, or logistics environment is an advantage, but motivated candidates willing to learn are also welcome.
• You enjoy hands-on, physical work.
• You work accurately and pay attention to quality and detail.
• You can safely use hand tools and machinery.
• You can work independently as well as in a team.
• You have a good command of English to communicate on the work floor.
• You are reliable, motivated, and responsible.

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:Are you seeking a new challenge where you can utilize your physical strength and precision? Our client, a renowned company in pallet production, is looking for a Robot Operator for Pallet Production.

As a Robot Operator for Pallet Production, you will be responsible for operating the production robot. Your role includes preparing the workstation: arranging planks and components on the worktable, which are then automatically assembled by the robot. The job requires physical effort, is repetitive in nature, and takes place in a noisy environment. Therefore, we are looking for someone who is up for the challenge.

Your tasks include:

• Preparing and placing planks and components on the worktable.
• Operating and monitoring the production robot.
• Ensuring a safe and efficient work environment.
• Collaborating with the team to ensure smooth production processes.

Profile DescriptionWhat are we looking for?

We are seeking an energetic and physically strong individual who meets the following requirements:

• You are physically fit and comfortable with repetitive tasks.
• You are flexible: until September, you will work in a day shift, and afterward in a two-shift system (morning and afternoon shifts).
• You can communicate in Dutch or English to collaborate effectively with the team.
• You work accurately and have attention to detail.
• You have prior experience in a production environment.

Our client specializes in dredging works. They provide dredging and maintenance services for waterways, ports and coastlines. Their scope of work includes sediment removal, land reclamation, and improving navigability.

Jobomschrijving

Work location: The company headquarters is located in Zwijnaarde; projects are in the Ghent area? Accommodation is not provided

Are you an experienced formwork carpenter? Or maybe you don’t have experience yet but are eager to learn? Is safety and quality your priority? If so, our client is looking for you!

Job Description:

We are looking for Formwork Carpenters to work on various construction projects. The person in this role will be responsible for assembling and dismantling formwork used to shape concrete structural elements.

Responsibilities:

• Preparation, assembly and dismantling of traditional and system formwork (e.g., Peri, Doka).• Carrying out reinforcement and formwork according to technical drawings.• Quality control of completed formwork and ensuring compliance with the project specifications.• Close cooperation with other team members and the site manager.• Ensuring workplace safety and compliance with health and safety regulations.

Requirements:

• Ability to read technical drawings.• Experience as a formwork carpenter or construction worker, welder, or fitter.• Communicative knowledge of English, Dutch, or French.• Ability to work in a team and independently perform assigned tasks.• VCA certificate is an advantage.• Category B driving licence.

Company Activities:

Join a company committed to excellence in maritime operations. Our client prides themselves on their dedication to safety, innovation, and teamwork. Their mission is to deliver top-notch dredging services with a focus on environmental sustainability and client satisfaction. As part of their team, you’ll be contributing to projects that shape the waterways of northern Europe, ensuring they remain navigable and efficient for all maritime traffic.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a skilled Captain for Tugboat looking for an exciting opportunity to showcase your expertise? Join our client’s dynamic team and navigate the waters of northern France and Belgium. Your primary mission will be to provide essential support to a dredging pontoon, ensuring smooth operations and safe passage through these regions.

Key Responsibilities:

• Navigate and operate the tugboat efficiently in collaboration with dredging operations.
• Ensure the mechanical upkeep of the tugboat, supported by the client’s team of technicians.
• Maintain tidiness and order on board, ensuring a safe and pleasant environment.
• Coordinate with French-speaking and Flemish-speaking teams to ensure seamless communication and operations.

Profile Description:

Our client is seeking an independent and responsible individual to take on the role of Captain for Tugboat. The ideal candidate will possess:

• A strong mechanical knowledge, essential for the maintenance and operation of the tugboat.
• CRR holder credentials.
• A driving licence and access to a car for easy mobility.
• A B licence (river) and A licence (river   coastal) to navigate various waterways.
• Proficiency in English, French, or Dutch to effectively communicate with diverse teams.

Our client is a well-established manufacturing company based in Drongen, specializing in the production of high-quality coffins. To strengthen their production team, they are looking for a motivated Machine Operator (CNC Milling Machine) to join their permanent night shift.

Jobomschrijving

Your Responsibilities

• Operate a CNC milling/routing machine.
• Monitor the production process and ensure smooth machine operation.
• Perform quality checks on finished products.
• Maintain a safe and organized work environment.
• Assist with material handling when required.

Your Profile

• Experience operating CNC machinery is an advantage.
• Forklift experience or a valid forklift certificate is considered a strong plus.
• You are willing to complete a training period of approximately 3 months in either the early or late shift before transitioning to the permanent night shift.
• You can communicate effectively in Dutch, English, or French.
• You are detail-oriented and committed to quality.
• You are reliable and comfortable working in a production environment.

Our client operates a network of physical stores and digital channels across Belgium and the Netherlands. To support ongoing business transformation and operational excellence initiatives, the company is looking for a Business Process Analyst to join a dynamic team focused on process optimization, user support, and continuous improvement.

Jobomschrijving

As a Business Process Analyst, you will act as a key link between operational teams and technology stakeholders. You will help analyze, document, improve, and support business processes across store operations, digital activities, and back-office functions. This position combines business analysis, process improvement, stakeholder management, and operational support, making it ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how a business works and driving tangible improvements.Key Responsibilities

• Analyze and document end-to-end business processes across retail and digital operations.
• Gather, challenge, and translate business requirements into actionable solutions.
• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, service quality, and user experience.
• Support business users by investigating operational issues and coordinating solutions with internal teams.
• Participate in projects related to process optimization, digital transformation, and operational excellence.
• Organize workshops with stakeholders to understand needs and define future processes.
• Develop process maps, business documentation, and functional requirements.
• Promote a culture of continuous improvement and help monitor the effectiveness of implemented solutions.
• Work closely with cross-functional teams in Belgium and the Netherlands.

• Experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, Functional Analyst, or in a similar position.
• Previous exposure to retail, omnichannel, customer service, supply chain, or operational environments is an asset.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Able to understand business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
• Comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels of the organization.
• Experience with process mapping and continuous improvement methodologies.
• Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Visio, SAP, Salesforce, or similar is considered a plus.
• Dutch: mandatory ; English: excellent professional level

For our client in the Kortrijk region, we are looking for a motivated Carpet Finishing Operator to strengthen our team on the finishing line.

 

• Cutting and finishing carpets to size

• Processing carpets on the finishing line

• Carrying out quality checks

• Attaching fringes when necessary

• Applying labels to carpets

• Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish

Job Requirements:

• You are precise and enjoy working with your hands

• You have an eye for quality and attention to detail

• You can work independently, but you are also a team player

• Experience in carpets, textiles or garment manufacturing is a plus

• Experience is not required: motivation and a positive work attitude are important

• You speak Dutch, French or English

jobs.occupation: Extrusion Operator – 2 Shifts & Permanent Night Shift
jobs.description:
For a company in regio Wielsbeke we are looking for motivated and technically skilled Extrusion Operators to join the production team. We have opportunities available in both a two-shift system (early and late shifts) and a permanent night shift.

As an Extrusion Operator, you will be responsible for operating and monitoring extrusion machinery to ensure efficient production and consistent product quality.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Operate and monitor extrusion machines and production lines.

• Set up machines and adjust process parameters according to production requirements.

• Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with quality standards.

• Perform routine quality checks and make adjustments when necessary.

• Identify and report machine malfunctions or production issues.

• Carry out basic cleaning and maintenance tasks.

• Follow all health, safety, and production procedures.

• Work closely with colleagues and supervisors to achieve production targets.

 

Your Profile:

• Experience in extrusion or a similar production environment is an advantage.

• Technical understanding and a hands-on approach.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Flexible and willing to work either a two-shift system or a permanent night shift.

• Reliable, motivated, and eager to learn.

• You speak English or Dutch fluently.

Do you have experience in production or a technical background, and are you willing to work in shifts? Do you speak Dutch or English fluently?

• As a Production Worker, you will be responsible for making safety boots.

• Assembling components (steel toe cap, lining and steel sole) onto the mould

• Cleaning the machine

• After completing internal training, you will also be able to operate two other machines

• Experience as a production worker is required

• You are eager to learn and have a strong focus on quality

• You have your own means of transport

• You have a good command of Dutch or English

As a Press Line Machine Operator, you are responsible for operating the equipment on the press line, ensuring that the clay is shaped and compacted to the correct form and density before the bricks enter the kiln.  Your Key Responsibilities:

• Preparing the production line according to the planned production schedule.

• Setting up and changing over the equipment to meet the required specifications.

• Operating the production line and monitoring/adjusting parameters in accordance with established procedures.

• Managing the loading and unloading of the drying chambers.

• Replenishing the hood kiln.

• Monitoring and adjusting the quality of the bricks produced.

• Recording production data and technical observations.

• Carrying out minor maintenance tasks and ensuring a clean and tidy working environment. 

Who Are You?

 

• You have a technical qualification or a strong technical aptitude.

• You have a basic understanding of automated equipment and systems.

• You have several years of experience as a machine operator or in operating more complex equipment, preferably in a production environment.

• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.

• You are willing to work day shifts, starting at 7:30 a.m.

jobs.occupation: Senior Finance Officer - Asset Management - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established and fast-growing asset management company based in Brussels, managing tens of billions of euros in assets on behalf of retail, private banking, and institutional clients. The organization has experienced significant growth in recent years and continues to expand its investment platform and international footprint.With a collaborative and entrepreneurial culture, the company combines the stability of a major financial institution with the agility of a specialized investment business.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as a trusted finance partner and deputy to the CFO when required.
• Prepare and review financial reports, management accounts, and regulatory reporting.
• Coordinate monthly and annual closing activities.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning exercises.
• Conduct financial analysis, scenario modelling, and business performance reviews.
• Support internal and external audit processes.
• Participate in strategic projects such as fund launches and international expansion initiatives.
• Guide and support junior team members on technical finance matters.
• Drive process improvements and reporting automation initiatives.

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Engineering, or equivalent.
• Minimum 7 years of experience within financial services.
• Experience in asset management, fund administration, private banking, investment services, or a regulated financial environment.
• Strong knowledge of accounting principles and GAAP.
• Solid experience with budgeting, reporting, and financial analysis.
• Ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
• Hands-on mindset combined with strategic thinking.
• Previous exposure to coaching or supporting junior colleagues is an asset.
• Fluent in English plus either French or Dutch.
• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Our client is one of Belgium's leading asset management firms, responsible for approximately €40 billion in assets under management (AUM) across investment funds and discretionary portfolios. With ambitious growth plans targeting €65 billion AUM by 2030, the organization continues to invest in top talent to strengthen its investment capabilities.Operating in a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment, the business combines the scale of a major financial institution with the agility of a fast-growing asset manager. Investment decisions are made in-house, with close collaboration between portfolio management, investment strategy, and external asset managers.

Jobomschrijving

• Monitor financial markets, macroeconomic developments, and geopolitical events to develop investment insights and recommendations.
• Contribute to strategic asset allocation decisions across multi-asset portfolios.
• Analyze investment opportunities and formulate portfolio construction recommendations.
• Support investment committees through market research, presentations, and strategic reporting.
• Evaluate and challenge internal and external investment views using quantitative and qualitative analysis.
• Oversee and assess internally managed and third-party funds, monitoring performance and positioning.
• Partner closely with portfolio managers to influence investment decisions and fund selection.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of investment processes, research methodologies, and monitoring frameworks.
• Prepare investment reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and commercial teams.

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Engineering, or related field.
• Minimum 4 years of experience in asset management, portfolio management, investment strategy, fund research, or investments.
• Strong analytical capabilities combined with a strategic and forward-looking mindset.
• Solid understanding of financial markets, macroeconomics, and asset allocation.
• Experience analyzing investment funds and/or multi-asset portfolios.
• Ability to transform complex financial information into actionable investment recommendations.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills.
• CFA, CEFA, or equivalent certification is considered a strong advantage.
• Fluent English required. French and/or Dutch are advantageous.

Our client is an international company active in a Industrial / Manufacturing industry, with operations across Europe and Africa. The organization is currently looking for an HR Freelance Support during a key transition period.

Jobomschrijving

As an HR Freelance Support your responsibilities are:

• Manage end-to-end HR operations for multiple countries.
• Coordinate payroll processes using Workday, Officient and external providers.
• Handle employee administration, holiday requests and HR documentation.
• Support payroll activities in Belgium, Denmark and South Africa.
• Ensure compliance with CP207 and internal HR policies.
• Act as the primary HR contact for employees and managers.
• Support process improvements and maintain HR data accuracy across systems.

As a HR Freelance Support your responsibilities are:

• Proven experience in a broad HR Generalist, HR Manager or HRBP role
• Strong operational HR mindset with a hands-on approach.
• Experience managing international payroll activities.
• Familiarity with Securex and Officient is highly preferred.
• Working knowledge of Workday and HRIS environments.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.
• Able to work independently and start on short notice.
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.

Our client is looking for an ICT Operations & Support to support end users and IT operations across several international locations. This position combines hands-on technical support, workplace technologies management, and coordination with global IT teams to ensure a seamless user experience and reliable IT services. It's a temporary contract with the possibility of a permanent position.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide first and second-line support for workplace technologies, end-user devices, and business applications.
• Act as the primary IT contact for multiple international locations, ensuring effective user support and service continuity.
• Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity, and collaboration tool issues.
• Coordinate with central service desk and infrastructure teams to manage incidents and escalations.
• Support the diagnosis of networking and telephony-related issues.
• Contribute to international IT projects, technology deployments, and infrastructure initiatives.
• Maintain accurate IT documentation, asset inventories, and ensure compliance with security standards and procedures.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in ICT Operations, Digital Workplace, End-User Computing, or IT Support environments.
• Strong knowledge of: Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint), Microsoft Copilot
• Good understanding of networking fundamentals:
• Experience working within IT service management environments and centralized support structures.
• English: professional proficiency required ; any other language is a plus

The organisation operates in the retail industry in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a GL Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Maintain accurate financial records and ensure transactions are recorded correctly.
• P&L analysis
• Preparing for financial audits
• Preparation of the monthly balance sheet
• Reconciliations
• Actins as point of contact with the banks
• Prepare and review journal entries to support reliable financial data.
• Check supporting documents to ensure complete and consistent accounting records.
• ...

A successful GL Accountant should have:

• Bachelor's degree in accounting & finance (or related field)
• 1 to 3 years' experience in accounting/finance
• Strong motivation, passion and ambition
• Fluency in French and Dutch, with a professional level of English
• Advanced Excel skills
• Experience with ERP systems
• Comfort working with finance colleagues on accounting matters.
